name: Gavin
source:
Kai has been picked on by Gavin ever since they were kids. Due to being constantly mocked by his nemesis, he's tried his best to change his appearance to be more intimidating. Gavin's only motive is to get Kai's attention, but instead, he's now hated by his crush.

Likes: Animals, Science
Dislikes: Filth, Percy
